translations.web: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
translations.bsb: His flesh wastes away from sight, and his hidden bones protrude.
translations.kjv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
translations.asv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones that were not seen stick out.
